cohort: 988,988 singleton term deliveries in Sweden between 2005 and 2016
finding: Primiparity, instrumental delivery, and high birthweight were significantly associated with an increased risk of OASIS, while smoking and low maternal education were associated with a decreased risk.
mod_finding: Vacuum extraction (aRR 2.79, 95% CI 2.73-2.86) and forceps (aRR 4.27, 95% CI 3.86-4.72) deliveries were associated with an increased risk of OASIS.
